content:
CPython 3.13’s experimental free-threading mode lets the runtime run with the GIL disabled. But what happens next can depend on the extensions an application imports.

If an extension has no explicit declaration that it supports free threading, CPython issues a warning and enables the GIL. The way an extension makes that declaration depends on whether it uses multi-phase or single-phase initialization.

That declaration signals compatibility with the runtime mode; it does not make the extension’s code thread-safe. Those are separate responsibilities for extension authors.
